secrets.valueProviderHelp.zh-CN: “公司”存储一个共享值；“每位用户”允许所有成员在“我的密钥”中提供自己的值。

secrets.vaultBrokenAgentWarning.en: Agents can't read this secret until the vault is fixed.
secrets.vaultBrokenAgentWarning.zh-CN: 在修复密钥库前，智能体无法读取此密钥。

secrets.vaultComingSoonCardNotice.en: Paperclip can't store or read secrets here yet.
secrets.vaultComingSoonCardNotice.zh-CN: Paperclip 暂不支持在此存储或读取密钥。

secrets.vaultComingSoonFormNotice.en: {{provider}} vaults can be saved, but Paperclip can't store or read secrets in them yet.
secrets.vaultComingSoonFormNotice.zh-CN: 可以保存 {{provider}} 密钥库配置，但 Paperclip 暂不支持在其中存储或读取密钥。

secrets.vaultDisabledCardNotice.en: Secrets can't be stored in or read from this vault while it is disabled.
secrets.vaultDisabledCardNotice.zh-CN: 禁用期间无法向此密钥库存储或从中读取密钥。

secrets.vaultDisabledFormNotice.en: This vault is disabled. Enable it from the vault's menu to use it for secrets.
secrets.vaultDisabledFormNotice.zh-CN: 此密钥库已禁用。请从密钥库菜单启用它以用于存储密钥。

secrets.vaultSettingsOnlyDescription.en: Only settings are saved here. Credentials stay with Paperclip's server.
secrets.vaultSettingsOnlyDescription.zh-CN: 此处仅保存设置，凭据保留在 Paperclip 服务器端。

secrets.vaultsDescription.en: Where secret values are kept. Paperclip encrypts them itself unless you connect a vault of your own.
secrets.vaultsDescription.zh-CN: 密钥值的存储位置。除非连接你自己的密钥库，否则由 Paperclip 自行加密保管。
